message: Per-job DOLLAR cost is not something Comfy Cloud reports today — pricing is rated at invoice level. What you can get: this feed for what each job used (gpu_seconds on cloud GPU runs; on API-node runs a credits_used figure, which is Comfy Cloud’s own display estimate in credits, not an invoiced amount), get_usage_report for actual spend broken down by model/endpoint/product, and estimate_credits for an approximate credit cost of a workflow before running it.
